title: Life Beyond the Visible
intro: The exhibition is organized into seven curated collections, each exploring a different aspect of the living world through scientific imagery, artistic expression and visual storytelling.

collections.title: The Architecture of Life
collections.subtitle: Exploring the hidden structures that sustain living systems.
collections.text: Discover the intricate organization of cells, organelles and molecular structures. Through advanced scientific imaging, this collection reveals the extraordinary architecture within cells and the interconnected systems that support life.

collections.title: The Shape of Life
collections.subtitle: Discovering the extraordinary diversity of biological forms.
collections.text: From delicate protein filaments resembling a hummingbird in flight to intricate cellular landscapes, this collection explores the relationship between biological structure, movement and artistic form. It reveals the unexpected beauty and diversity of shapes within the microscopic world.

collections.title: The Energy Within
collections.subtitle: Illuminating the microscopic machinery that powers life.
collections.text: Explore the fascinating world of mitochondria and the molecular structures that help sustain cellular activity. This collection reveals the intricate networks, dynamic transformations and biological processes associated with energy production.

collections.title: Life Under Pressure
collections.subtitle: Exploring the relationship between cellular function, stress and disease.
collections.text: Living systems continuously respond to changes in their surroundings. Through scientific imagery of oxidative stress, cellular disruption and viral infection, this collection offers a visual perspective on the vulnerability and complexity of biological systems.

collections.title: Beyond the Limits of Vision
collections.subtitle: Expanding human perception through scientific innovation.
collections.text: Advanced imaging technologies allow us to observe biological structures that were once beyond the limits of human vision. This collection celebrates the power of super-resolution microscopy and three-dimensional visualization to reveal new dimensions of the living world.

collections.title: Life in Motion
collections.subtitle: Experiencing the dynamic nature of living systems.
collections.text: Life is never truly still. Through scientific videography, live-cell imaging and time-lapse microscopy, this collection captures the continuous movement, interaction and reorganization of cellular structures, revealing biological processes as dynamic visual experiences.

collections.title: Echoes of Nature
collections.subtitle: Discovering visual parallels between the microscopic and visible worlds.
collections.text: The patterns revealed through scientific microscopy often bear striking similarities to those found in our everyday surroundings. From the delicate trajectories of flying sparks to the overlapping colours of autumn leaves, this collection explores the shared visual language of science, nature and art.
